title: Gus and the Engine That Pushed Back
synopsis: Gus and Jack observe a remote engine test. A reading triggers a calm engineering pause; a measuring connection is repaired and retested.
continuity_state: Before: Star One's components are in integration and engine tests are underway; the full rocket is not yet at the pad. After: The planned test ends with a repaired sensor connection and checked readings; no unaddressed engine issue remains.
